tool.name: Biomni: Docking Autodock Vina
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.pharmacology import docking_autodock_vina
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = docking_autodock_vina(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --smiles_list '$smiles_list' --receptor_pdb_file '$receptor_pdb_file' --box_center '$box_center' --box_size '$box_size' #if $ncpu --ncpu '$ncpu' #end if
